title: Chart Industries
summary: US maker of cryogenic tanks, liquefaction equipment and gas-handling systems.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Chart Industries builds cryogenic storage tanks, liquefiers, pumps and gas-handling equipment for industrial gas, hydrogen, LNG and space customers. Launch sites need large liquid-oxygen and liquid-nitrogen supply, and Chart's tanks and vaporisers sit in that infrastructure. Clean-energy projects add growth and cyclicality.

Technology Exposure

  • Cryogenic tanks and vaporisers
  • Liquefaction and gas-processing equipment
  • Hydrogen and LNG infrastructure

What To Watch

  • Hydrogen and LNG project awards
  • Industrial gas capex
  • Integration and leverage

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
